description: Expected outcomes for gatebraid/metrics@1. This corpus exists because the internal N1 review found the schema had been written with no fixtures at all: its central three-result-state separation — described in the schema as 'the whole point of this schema' — was trusted having never been shown able to fail, which ADR-0028 §1 forbids in one sentence ('a pass from a never-falsified check is not evidence'). Every expectation below was MEASURED with CPython 3.12.2 / jsonschema 4.23.0. Loci are exact and complete; the runner rejects both a missing locus and an unrecorded one. Amended at M3 batch N1C (A3): a locus is now (keyword, path, schema_path, property, extra_count) and every `required` expectation records WHICH property is missing, derived from the validator's own per-property error rather than written by hand. This manifest was rewritten by that amendment even though its own cases were not the ones the ruling named: the runner raises a structure error on any `required` expectation lacking `property`, so leaving it untouched would have made the whole corpus exit 2. A forced consequence, recorded rather than presented as a discretionary extension. Amended at M3 batch N1D: a locus additionally carries the error's `schema_path` (D6 — an instance path cannot say which branch of a conditional fired) and, for `additionalProperties`, an `extra_count` (external review R1 — one and two unexpected properties produced identical loci, so an over-mutated fixture passed a manifest recording one). Every locus in this file was re-measured against the N1D-amended schemas, not carried forward.

known_limitation: No residual collision in this corpus as of M3 batch N1D, measured by sweeping every corpus for identical (schema, locus set) pairs. MT1-05/MT1-08 shared `not@metrics/0` until D6 added the error's `schema_path`, which separates them at `allOf/0/else` versus `allOf/2/then`. The residual pairs elsewhere are EC1-28/EC1-29 and GR2-09/GR2-12, each recorded in its own manifest. What remains unenforceable here is unchanged and is a property of JSON Schema rather than of this corpus: no keyword relates one instance value to another, so cross-property relations are N3 re-derivation duties. F3 RESIDUAL (N1D): `evidence_only_abort_flag` carries NO value-type constraint. convergence-metrics-v2 §5 defines it as neither a count/rate nor one of the readings/intervals — it says 'per-slice it is a flag' — so no family classifies it, and an inert branch asserting the base type would be unfalsifiable. Left unconstrained and escalated for operator ruling rather than forced into a family the committed text does not put it in.
